comment: Communities/districts along the full Airport→Kingston→Bog Walk→Fern Gully→Ocho Rios route. Lat/lon are approximate community centres. 'needs_owner_review' marks entries where map data was used and owner's lived knowledge should confirm. Used by recognition layer 2 (community signs) in recognition.ts.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The narrow spit connecting the airport to Kingston — sea on both sides, coconut trees lining the road.

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Eastern gateway community at the end of the Palisadoes; major roundabout where the airport road meets Windward Road.

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: East Kingston industrial community. The old fort is nearby.

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: Hillside Rastafarian community above east Kingston. Known for nyahbinghi drumming.

communities.name: Rollington Town
communities.note: Inner-city Kingston community along the Windward Road corridor.

communities.name: Allman Town
communities.note: Historic downtown Kingston neighbourhood.

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Major commercial junction in central Kingston — where Maxfield Ave meets Slipe Road.

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Kingston's modern commercial and financial hub. Hotels, offices, Emancipation Park.

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: The unofficial capital of Kingston — the clock tower, buses everywhere, pure vibes.

communities.name: Constant Spring
communities.note: Uptown residential area along Constant Spring Road. Usain Bolt's Tracks & Records is here.

communities.name: Trench Town
communities.note: Bob Marley's home community. The music that changed the world came from here.

communities.name: Arnett Gardens
communities.note: Known locally as 'The Jungle'. Fierce community pride.

communities.name: Twickenham Park
communities.note: Community on the outskirts of Spanish Town, along the main route west.

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Market town at the entrance to the gorge. Fresh produce, bammy and festivals by the roadside.

communities.name: Flat Bridge
communities.note: The narrows of Bog Walk gorge — this old bridge floods when the Rio Cobre rises. Legendary spot.

communities.name: Point Hill
communities.note: Small farming community in the hills above the gorge.

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: "Linstead Market" — the folk song is about this town. Market town, busy and real.

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Bauxite country. The old alumina plant road forks off here.

communities.name: Guy's Hill
communities.note: Agricultural community in the hills between Linstead and Moneague.

communities.name: Mount Rosser
communities.note: High point before the descent to Moneague — that's where the wrong-turn off-road option lives.

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Mountain crossroads town where St. Ann and St. Mary meet. Cool breeze up here.

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: The famous roadside cookshop strip — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival, cold drinks. Pull over.

communities.name: Claremont
communities.note: St. Ann community at the northern end of the descent toward Ocho Rios.

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Three kilometres of canopy-covered road — bamboo and tree ferns arching overhead. No other road like it in the Caribbean.

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Tourism capital of the north coast. White sand, cruise ships, Dunn's River around the corner.
